Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Jrue Holiday?

Jrue Holiday is 36 years old.

Where was Jrue Holiday born?

Jrue Holiday was born in Chatsworth, California.

When was Jrue Holiday born?

Jrue Holiday was born on June 12, 1990.

How tall is Jrue Holiday?

Jrue Holiday is 6-4 (193 cm) tall.

How much does Jrue Holiday weigh?

Jrue Holiday weighs 220 lbs (99 kg).

Is Jrue Holiday in the Hall of Fame?

Jrue Holiday is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Jrue Holiday drafted?

Jrue Holiday was drafted by Philadelphia 76ers, 1st round (17th pick, 17th overall), 2009 NBA Draft.

What position does Jrue Holiday play?

Point Guard and Shooting Guard.

What is Jrue Holiday's net worth?

Jrue Holiday has made at least $315,288,576 playing professional basketball.

How much does Jrue Holiday make?

Jrue Holiday made $36,861,707 in 2024.

How many rings does Jrue Holiday have?

Jrue Holiday has won 2 championships.

What is Jrue Holiday's Instagram account?

Jrue Holiday is on Instagram at jrue_holiday11.

What schools did Jrue Holiday attend?

Jrue Holiday attended Campbell Hall in North Hollywood, California and UCLA.

What are Jrue Holiday's nicknames?

JHolla, The Jruth, Kung fu Jrue are nicknames for Jrue Holiday.
